name: Fellow
description_en:
Fellow supports the preparation and follow-up work surrounding team meetings and one-to-one conversations. Its directory overview describes collaborative agendas, a shared place for tasks, and action items captured from discussions. Feedback can be exchanged through the web experience or Slack. These functions connect meeting preparation with the responsibilities agreed during a conversation, making it easier to revisit commitments and subsequent progress. The source also lists AI meeting notes and transcription in plan descriptions, but this profile does not infer their current quotas or availability. Teams should check their required meeting integrations, recording controls and plan conditions against official documentation.

Fellow is a product in the AI meeting assistants category. Its directory profile covers Meeting Agenda Management, Meeting Action Items, Team Feedback, Follow-up Tracking.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $7.0. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.
description_zh:
Fellow 用于团队会议和一对一沟通前后的准备及跟进。第三方介绍涉及共同编写议程、集中整理任务，以及从讨论中记录行动项。成员可以通过网页或 Slack 交换反馈。这些功能把会议准备与讨论中约定的责任连接起来，便于回顾承诺事项及后续进展。来源中的方案介绍还提到 AI 会议笔记和转写，本档案未据此推断当前额度或实际可用范围；团队仍需核对所需集成、录制控制及方案条件。

Fellow 属于AI 会议辅助软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括会议议程管理、会议行动项、团队反馈、后续事项跟踪。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $7.0. 另有持续免费方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。
